name: B10-0081/2025 (PPE) – Case of Jean-Jacques Wondo in the Democratic Republic of the Congo
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the case of Jean-Jacques Wondo in the Democratic Republic of the Congo
part_text:
The European Parliament is calling for the release of Jean-Jacques Wondo, a Belgian-Congolese researcher sentenced to death in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Members say the case against him had no concrete evidence and his trial was not fair. They also ask Congo to stop using the death penalty and to bring back a pause on executions. The Parliament is not passing a law here; it is stating its position and pressing the Congolese authorities to act.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament asks Congo to free Wondo and halt executions.
- **Who it affects:** Wondo, other death row prisoners in Congo, and Congo's government.
- **What happens next:** The resolution is sent to Congo's leaders and European Union bodies to push for action.
